about: The env names a recipe never sets, because they change what runs rather than what the app is configured with (validate.go isControlEnv, recipe.ts isControlEnv). One file for the worker and the cell: apps/runtime-cell/internal/recipe/recipe-control-env.json is a byte copy (go:embed), and both sides test that it is identical and that their parser refuses every name, every prefix and every refused case below, and accepts every allowed case. A name is compared upper-cased: an exact name in names, or one that starts with a prefix.
